# go-link-monitor on the rocm-ernic virtual ionic NIC, per profile

Each column is one guest: the in-tree ionic and ionic_rdma drivers bound to rocm-ernic with the given `--nic-profile`, a TAP peer, ping and TCP SYN traffic from every vCPU, an RDMA RC ping-pong, and, where rocm-ernic provides it, ernic-rdma-errors making each RDMA error happen once. The values are what go-link-monitor exported; the driver's own view (ethtool, ip -s link, sysfs) is beside each guest's scrapes.

## compat

netdev `eth0`, RDMA device `ionic_0`, 8 vCPUs, `--nic-profile compat`.

Nonzero RDMA hw_counters: `commands` 213, `req_rx_cqe_err` 3, `req_rx_remote_access_err` 2, `req_tx_memory_mgmt_err` 1, `resp_rx_cqe_err` 2, `resp_rx_local_len_err` 1, `resp_rx_out_of_buffer` 1, `resp_tx_remote_access_err` 2, `resp_tx_rnr_retry_err` 2,604, `total_bytes_rdma_read` 64, `total_bytes_rdma_write` 64, `total_bytes_received` 4,096,144, `total_bytes_sent` 4,096,256.

<details><summary>ernic-rdma-errors</summary>

```
device ionic_0, GID index 1
ok negative: RDMA WRITE, RDMA READ and SEND that all succeed
ok positive: RDMA WRITE with an unregistered rkey; req_rx_remote_access_err +1, req_rx_cqe_err +1, resp_tx_remote_access_err +1
ok positive: RDMA WRITE whose local SGE names an unregistered lkey; req_rx_cqe_err +1, req_tx_memory_mgmt_err +1
ok positive: SEND of 64 bytes into a 16-byte receive; resp_rx_cqe_err +1, resp_rx_local_len_err +1
ok positive: fetch-and-add with an unregistered rkey; req_rx_remote_access_err +1, req_rx_cqe_err +1, resp_tx_remote_access_err +1
ok boundary: SEND with no receive posted for 500 ms, then one; resp_tx_rnr_retry_err +2604, resp_rx_out_of_buffer +1
ok corner: SEND whose source SGE names an unregistered lkey; resp_rx_cqe_err +1
exit 0
```

</details>

## generic-100g-faults

netdev `eth0`, RDMA device `ionic_0`, 8 vCPUs, `--nic-profile generic-100g --inject eth_rx: every 10 effect nobuf --inject eth_tx: every 10 effect drop`.

Nonzero RDMA hw_counters: `commands` 240, `req_rx_cqe_err` 3, `req_rx_remote_access_err` 2, `req_tx_memory_mgmt_err` 1, `resp_rx_cqe_err` 2, `resp_rx_local_len_err` 1, `resp_rx_out_of_buffer` 1, `resp_tx_remote_access_err` 2, `resp_tx_rnr_retry_err` 2,586, `total_bytes_rdma_read` 64, `total_bytes_rdma_write` 64, `total_bytes_received` 4,096,144, `total_bytes_sent` 4,096,256.

ok boundary: SEND with no receive posted for 500 ms, then one; resp_tx_rnr_retry_err +2586, resp_rx_out_of_buffer +1
